description: This file contains serializers, surrogates, and copiers for the ArrayList type used within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It defines classes for serialization, deserialization, deep copying, and surrogate representation of ArrayList objects.

classes.name: ArrayListCodec
classes.description: Serializer class for ArrayList objects, converting between ArrayList and its surrogate.

classes.name: ArrayListSurrogate
classes.description: Surrogate data structure used to serialize ArrayList.

classes.name: ArrayListCopier
classes.description: Handles deep copying of ArrayList instances.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the ArrayList.

methods.name: DeepCopy (overload)
methods.description: Copies elements from one ArrayList to another.
